source: Controlled serial scenario calendar. Operation durations and disconnect delay are declared test inputs, not emulator wall time or measured Google Cloud duration. CPU/RAM pricing retains its separate low/nominal/high model.
participantSchedule: Serial synthetic responses, each after the previous on_data_update submission settles. Runtime advancement after local backup remains allowed while that submission flushes.
realtimeCalendar: RTDB writes and rule validation retain native server timestamps. Raw SDK/event bytes are counted before exposing a copied presence calendar view to handlers; planned disconnect actions provide their scenario timestamp.
httpDelivery: After the registered event/task dispatcher reaches quiescence; retries at future deadlines remain queued.
